instruction: Enable the minimal view mode in VLC to hide the menu bar and toolbar.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires enabling minimal view mode in VLC to hide menu/toolbar. Agent can use View > Minimal View or Ctrl+H. Reuses existing check_qt_minimal_view metric which reads VLC config file (vlcrc) and checks qt-minimal-view=1.
metadata.verification: Reuses existing VLC functions: get_vlc_config getter reads vlcrc file, check_qt_minimal_view metric verifies qt-minimal-view=1.
